test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "transmits."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use** "transmits"** in the blank is to convey the idea that body language sends or communicates ideas or thoughts.
 
• **"Transmits"** emphasizes the act of conveying or sending signals through body movements, whether it's done consciously (intentionally) or unconsciously (unintentionally). ("Transmits" शरीर के आंदोलनों के माध्यम से संकेत देने या भेजने के कार्य पर जोर देता है, चाहे यह जानबूझकर (जानबूझकर) या अनजाने में (अनजाने में) किया गया हो।)
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct paragraph: 

Body language **transmits**__ ideas or thoughts by certain actions, either intentionally or unintentionally. A ______ (2) ______ can be a way of flirting or indicating that the party is only joking. A ______ (3) ______ signifies approval, while ______ (4) ______ of the head indicates a negative reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Intermits: **suspend or discontinue (an action or practice) for a time. (कुछ समय के लिए (किसी कार्य या अभ्यास को) निलंबित या बंद करना)
 
• **Delimits: **determine the limits or boundaries of. (सीमा या सीमाएं निर्धारित करना)
 
• **Retransmits: **transmit (data, a radio signal, or a broadcast programme) again or on to another receiver. ((डेटा, एक रेडियो सिग्नल, या एक प्रसारण कार्यक्रम) दोबारा या किसी अन्य रिसीवर पर प्रसारित करना)
